f.title: Importers and distributors of reliance-registered products must still meet RIS Art 131
f.statement: Issuing a marketing authorisation (registro sanitario) through the abbreviated reliance pathway does not exempt importers, distributors and marketers of health supplies from complying with the requirements of Article 131 of the Health Supplies Regulation (RIS) and other rules applicable to marketing in Mexican territory.
f.legal_basis: Reglamento de Insumos para la Salud Art 131
f.applicability: Health supplies registered via the abbreviated reliance pathway

rows.actor: Importers, distributors and marketers of health supplies
rows.quote: ARTÍCULO 6.- La expedición del Registro Sanitario otorgado en los términos del presente instrumento, no exenta a los importadores, distribuidores y comercializadores de insumos para la salud del cumplimiento de los requisitos establecidos en el artículo 131 del Reglamento y demás normatividad aplicable para su comercialización en el territorio mexicano.
rows.review_note: Review: removed the extractor's gloss on the content of RIS Art 131 from the statement (not in the quote); norm Regulation confirmed (Acuerdo of the Secretario de Salud published in the DOF; Lineamientos are binding). Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. Actors explicit. Below 90: no modal verb ('no exenta' = not exempt); the obligation is a cross-reference to RIS Art 131.
rows.quote_en: ARTICLE 6.- The issuance of the Marketing Authorisation granted under this instrument does not exempt importers, distributors and marketers of health supplies from compliance with the requirements established in Article 131 of the Regulation and other applicable rules for their marketing in Mexican territory.

f.title: Report adverse reactions of reliance-registered products to COFEPRIS per RIS Art 38
f.statement: Marketing authorisation holders or their legal representatives, and distributors and marketers of health supplies registered through the abbreviated pathway, are obliged to inform COFEPRIS of adverse reactions occurring during marketing or use, in accordance with Article 38 of the Health Supplies Regulation, and of any other circumstance that must be reported to the competent authorities under applicable provisions.
f.legal_basis: Reglamento de Insumos para la Salud Art 38
f.applicability: Health supplies registered via the abbreviated reliance pathway
f.processes: Submission operations; Safety intake & collection; Case processing & follow-up

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder or legal representative; distributors and marketers
rows.quote: ARTÍCULO 9.- Los titulares de los registros sanitarios o sus representantes legales, así como los distribuidores y comercializadores de los insumos registrados conforme a este documento, tienen la obligación de informar a la COFEPRIS, las reacciones adversas de los insumos que se presenten durante su comercialización o uso, de conformidad con lo establecido en el artículo 38 del Reglamento, así como cualquier otra circunstancia que se deba reportar a las autoridades competentes, conforme a las disposiciones jurídicas aplicables.
rows.review_note: Review: no change; 'tienen la obligación de informar' = Mandatory; actor list (holders/legal representatives, distributors, marketers) matches. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. Actors explicit, 'tienen la obligación de informar' = Mandatory; no deadline in the quote (none set); statement adds nothing.
rows.quote_en: ARTICLE 9.- Marketing authorisation holders or their legal representatives, as well as distributors and marketers of the health supplies registered under this document, have the obligation to inform COFEPRIS of the adverse reactions of the health supplies that occur during their marketing or use, in accordance with Article 38 of the Regulation, as well as any other circumstance that must be reported to the competent authorities, in accordance with the applicable legal provisions.

f.title: State the intensive pharmacovigilance programme folio for biologics in reliance applications
f.statement: In Module 1 of a reliance application for medicines, applicants for biological products and biotechnological medicines shall indicate the number or folio of the application for the intensive pharmacovigilance programme, in accordance with the applicable provisions.
f.clause: Anexo Único, Capítulo IV, Sección I, Artículo 27, fracción I, inciso j
f.applicability: Biological products and biotechnological medicines applying via the abbreviated pathway

rows.actor: Applicant for marketing authorisation (biological and biotechnological medicines)
rows.quote: j. Para productos biológicos y medicamentos biotecnológicos se deberá indicar el número o folio de solicitud del programa de farmacovigilancia intensiva, de conformidad con las disposiciones que resulten aplicables.
rows.location: Anexo Único, Capítulo IV, Sección I, Artículo 27, fracción I, inciso j
rows.review_note: Review: no change; 'se deberá indicar' = Mandatory. Re-translation: agrees. Below 90: actor inferred; 'Module 1 of a reliance application' context comes from the Art 27 lead-in outside the quote.
rows.quote_en: j. For biological products and biotechnological medicines, the number or folio of the application for the intensive pharmacovigilance programme shall be indicated, in accordance with the applicable provisions.

f.title: Declare no foreign safety alerts or safety-related withdrawals for reliance applications
f.statement: The applicant shall declare under oath that the medicine or its intended use (indications, dosing regimens and age groups) has no special alerts or warnings from other National Regulatory Authorities or WHO and has not been withdrawn from the market in any country for safety and efficacy reasons.
f.clause: Anexo Único, Capítulo IV, Sección I, Artículo 30
f.applicability: Medicines applying via the abbreviated pathway
f.processes: Submission operations; Regulatory intelligence; Signal management

rows.quote: ARTÍCULO 30.- El solicitante deberá declarar bajo protesta de decir verdad, que el medicamento o su uso previsto (indicaciones, regímenes de dosificación y grupos etarios), no presentan alertas o advertencias especiales por parte de otras Autoridades Regulatorias Nacionales o la OMS, y tampoco ha sido retirado del mercado en cualquier país por motivos de seguridad y eficacia.
rows.location: Anexo Único, Capítulo IV, Sección I, Artículo 30
data_elements: market withdrawals for safety or efficacy
rows.review_note: Review: deadline cleared (the source sets no time frame; the declaration is part of the application). 'deberá declarar bajo protesta de decir verdad' = Mandatory. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. Actor explicit (el solicitante), 'deberá declarar' = Mandatory; statement adds nothing.
rows.quote_en: ARTICLE 30.- The applicant shall declare under oath that the medicine or its intended use (indications, dosing regimens and age groups) does not present special alerts or warnings from other National Regulatory Authorities or WHO, and has not been withdrawn from the market in any country for reasons of safety and efficacy.

f.title: Include a risk analysis and a technovigilance report in device reliance applications
f.statement: The technical information section of an application for medical-device registration by equivalence with a reference regulatory authority (form FF-COFEPRIS-01, Article 31) includes, among other items, the clinical evaluation, a risk analysis and a technovigilance report.
f.clause: Anexo Único, Capítulo IV, Sección II, Artículo 31, fracción II, numerales 6-9
f.applicability: Medical devices applying via the abbreviated pathway

rows.location: Anexo Único, Capítulo IV, Sección II, Artículo 31, fracción II, numerales 6-9

rows.quote_en: II. Technical information: 1. Introductory descriptive information on the medical device; 2. Description and specification of the main components, accessories and formulation; 3. Summary of the manufacturing process; 4. Conformity assessment submitted to the RRA, according to the nature and characteristics of the medical device, to guarantee its functionality and performance (summaries of processes and tests). 5. Description of primary and secondary packaging materials; 6. Clinical evaluation; 7. Risk analysis; 8. Analytical certificate or finished product certificate, and 9. Technovigilance report.
